items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: And Jay McShane, which is known as a blues pianist, and he was singing the blues, and he'd give us each a note to hit it and direct us as to when to hit it.

ctx.x: My uncle was working, my Uncle Presley was working with Jay McShane's band. He came to the house, which was right across from where my Uncle Oxlade's done. One corner, another uptown, downtown. And Jay McShane, which is known as a blues pianist, and he was singing the blues, and he'd give us each a note to hit it and direct us as to when to hit it.
Yeah, all this was in the 40s.
